carpet-air-mover.context: A snail-shaped floor fan with a round hub and curved air lines blowing out the side. Used for drying wet carpet after floods, leaks and spills, and in water damage restoration.

crack-stitching.context: A square wall with a zigzag crack held together by short metal bars laid across it. Used for masonry crack repair, structural wall repair and foundation maintenance guides.

bird-nest-in-vent.context: A round wall vent with horizontal slats and crossed twigs poking out through it. Marks blocked vents, pest and wildlife problems and exhaust cleaning jobs.

light-fixture-wiring.context: A small ceiling box with two wires hanging down to a flat light fixture. Used for installing or replacing a ceiling light and for electrical wiring guides.

cable-staple.context: A U-shaped staple pressed over a round cable on a wall surface. Used for securing electrical, network and coax cables to studs and trim.

damaged-siding.context: A wall of horizontal siding boards with a jagged, broken corner. Used for storm damage, exterior repair and home inspection notes.

loose-handrail.context: A sloped stair handrail on posts above steps, with one post tilted away from the stair. Used for stair safety checks, loose banister repairs and home inspection items.

sagging-gutter.context: A rain gutter drooping in the middle below the roof edge with a drop of water falling from it. Used for roof drainage problems, gutter repair and exterior maintenance.

popcorn-ceiling-removal.context: A bumpy textured ceiling edge with a long-handled scraper wiping it flat. Used for removing popcorn or acoustic ceiling texture during remodels.

paint-stripping.context: A scraper blade lifting bubbled paint off a board, with heat waves rising above. Used for heat stripping old paint, refinishing furniture and trim restoration.

paint-roller-grid.context: A square wire grid screen standing inside a paint bucket. Used for scraping excess paint off a roller before painting walls.

wallpaper-scorer.context: A domed hand tool with a small spiked wheel underneath. Used for perforating wallpaper before steaming or soaking it off the wall.

self-leveling-floor.context: A tipped bucket pouring liquid compound that spreads into a flat layer on the floor. Used for levelling uneven subfloors before laying new flooring.

concealed-cabinet-hinge.context: A cabinet door edge with a round cup hinge, an arm and a mounting plate with screws. Used for adjusting or replacing kitchen cabinet doors.

fridge-door-seal.context: A refrigerator door with its inner rubber gasket peeling away at one corner. Used for fridge seal replacement, cold air leaks and appliance repair.

dishwasher-filter.context: A cylindrical mesh filter with a twist handle on top above a flat round screen. Used for cleaning the dishwasher drain filter and appliance maintenance.

range-hood-filter.context: A rectangular metal filter panel with slanted slats and drops of grease below it. Used for cleaning kitchen exhaust hood grease filters.

fin-comb.context: A comb with a bar and three teeth over a row of cooling fins, two of them bent. Used for straightening bent condenser and air conditioner coil fins.

dripping-ceiling-light.context: A pendant light shade hanging from the ceiling with water drops falling from it. Marks ceiling leaks, water damage and electrical safety hazards.
